policy.question_text: Classify this user turn as exactly one of: conversation (the user wants an explanation or chat, no bounded choice), structured_decision (the user supplies explicit alternatives to pick from, even when phrased as a question), or clarify (the user's request is missing options, criteria, or scope and the assistant needs to ask before deciding).
policy.note: policy '3': injection guard + structure extractor + deterministic stage + Laya head
